title.narrative: 23M-CASH - Bale Wild - Market development for organic wild certified forest coffee (Ethiopia)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to establish a fair trade in organic wild collected coffee from sustainably managed forests that creates income opportunities and secures the livelihoods of local communities. The maturation grant is used to develop and set-up a viable business case between the international and local commercial partners, assisted by an experienced international NGO with strong local presence. Based on the int. commercial partner's experience in setting up similar trade agreements, the local commercial partner and ultimately coffee cultivating communities will receive capacity building and business counselling to build a profitable and sustainable business that meets the requirements of international fair trade. The sustainable protection of the ecosystem and thus the natural livelihoods of the communities is an essential part of the project's objective.
